idea-plugin.name: ComposeBridge
idea-plugin.description: Live UI tuning for Jetpack Compose. Scan your project for design tokens, detect hardcoded values, analyze impact, and suggest splits - all from Android Studio.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
v1.1.2 - Complete Refactoring & Critical Fixes

  • Architectural Refactoring: Split monolithic files into 25+ specialized modules (source_analyzer: 2116→72 lines).
  • Text Editing Fixed: Resolved relative imports and AppStrings resolution issues.
  • Multi-Registry Dimensions: Fixed padding edits on complex lines.
  • Release Builds: Added composebridge-runtime for flawless assembleRelease.
  • Privacy Cleanup: Removed all hardcoded paths from the codebase.
  • Verification: 100% E2E tests passing and fully tested on a real device.
